messages:
alex: Quick sync — thinking about how we tune the 'version signal' we'll use to gate deprecation rollouts. Proposal: add an opt-in header X-RW-Version: v4 and use cohort routing (sampled 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%). We measure 5xx, latency p95, and model-quality regressions against a small eval set. Thoughts?

maria: I like the explicit header opt-in. Question: how do we handle SDKs that don't set headers? auto-detect via client-agent? :thinking_face:

kevin: Prefer server-side cohort assignment + sticky cookie. Header should be an explicit override for testing only. Server assigns cohort via rollout service and sets cookie. Avoid sniffing user-agents — brittle.

jin: +1 to cookie sticky cohorts. Also propose concrete rollback thresholds: if 5xx increases by >0.5% absolute OR latency p95 regresses >20ms sustained for 10 minutes, trigger automated rollback. Add an escalation path after rollback.

alex: OK. Add telemetry buckets: rollout_cohort=control|canary so we can do A/B stats. We should also capture tenant_id, region, model_variant in traces for aggregation.

maria: We should track token-per-request delta too — cost regressions can be silent. Soft alert at +5% tokens/request vs baseline.

kevin: Ops items: sampling rate must be dynamic via feature flag. Need global kill-switch and per-tenant opt-out. Also support X-RW-Compat: legacy to explicitly request fallback semantics (no new behavior).

alex: Implementation sketch for routing layer (pseudo):
```pseudo
if req.headers['X-RW-Version']:
  route(req.headers['X-RW-Version'])  # explicit opt-in
elif cookie := req.cookies.get('rw_cohort'):
  route(cookie)                         # sticky cohort
else:
  cohort = rollout_service.sample(req.tenant_id)
  set_cookie('rw_cohort', cohort)
  route(cohort)
```

jin: Docs/semantics note: header = explicit opt-in (no billing semantics change), cookie = experimental cohort. Each step of sampling increases should have a 2-week observation window for non-critical tenants.

maria: Edge cases: what about long-lived streaming sessions? Need to pin session to cohort at start and honor that for the session lifecycle. Also consider KV-cache warmup impacts during cohorts.

kevin: Good catch. For streaming, assign cohort at session-init and embed cohort id in the connection metadata so any reconnects reuse it. Also instrument prefix-cache hit-rate.

deploy-bot: rollout-service change deployed to staging: https://staging.internal/rollout/125 :rocket:

maria: Action items: (1) Alex to draft RFC with thresholds, metrics, dashboard wireframes; (2) Kevin to add cookie sticky + kill-switch + header override; (3) Jin to author rollback runbook and streaming-session guidance. Sync in 3 days to review RFC. :calendar:

alex: I'll draft RFC today and ping for reviews. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
